notes: Adds API/revocation, integration, and test coverage stories to complete lifecycle management.

stories.title: Token Revocation and Blacklist Logic
stories.description: Implement explicit token revocation capability including revocation_status flag and optional blacklist lookup for immediate invalidation. Revoked tokens must be rejected during authentication and recorded in audit logs.

stories.title: Token Management API Endpoints
stories.description: Expose internal API endpoints for token lifecycle operations including rotate token, revoke token, and validate token status. Ensure endpoints are protected and aligned with existing Azure Function or FastAPI patterns.

stories.title: Authentication Flow Integration with GPTReader
stories.description: Integrate expiration, rotation, and revocation checks into GPTReader request handling path to ensure all incoming requests enforce full token lifecycle validation before data access.

stories.title: Token Lifecycle Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Develop comprehensive unit and integration tests covering token expiration, rotation chaining, revocation enforcement, and API endpoint behavior. Include edge cases such as race conditions and replay attempts.
